shared_or_similar_visual_information: An inequality involving x and a cutoff value beside a piecewise formula. Compare the input condition beside the curved branch in the left image with the input condition in the lower formula label in the right image.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The parabolic formula applies for x at least 1, including x = 1. Right image: The linear rule includes x = 1 as its left boundary.
